title: Separating Direct Event-Time Effects from Spillovers under Interactive Fixed Effects
banked_reason: The delivered novelty tier is incremental against a field floor; completing the arbitrary fixed-point-free permutation iff frontier is a genuine new research program, not a bounded repair.
gap_reasons: The note proves sharp target spaces only for complete mixing and one adoption-aligned cycle, plus boundary cases, a four-cohort counterexample, and one-sided robustness guarantees; it does not deliver the general known-network frontier suggested by the broader topic.

The arbitrary fixed-point-free permutation regime remains without a necessary-and-sufficient characterization, and the low-rank-departure and relative-cycle propositions establish only sufficient identified subspaces.

The framing accurately labels the missing permutation iff result as open, but the narrow population-only scope, absence of noisy-sample inference, and lack of an application keep the package below a field-level contribution and constrain its leading-journal score.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved and discharged sharp uniform target-space frontiers for no spillovers, complete mixing, and an adoption-aligned directed cycle, together with rank-split observational-equivalence witnesses, boundary results for arbitrary permutations, and an order-sensitive four-cohort counterexample. It also obtained sufficient low-rank-departure and relative-cycle guarantees, but could not turn these into the necessary-and-sufficient arbitrary fixed-point-free permutation classification required for field novelty. Final math and decision reviews passed with no findings; the general referee graded the clean package incremental below the field floor (paper-score ceiling 5.7 < 7.4).
tldr: Conditional on a prespecified additive cohort-level exposure response, the note establishes exact algebraic staircase frontiers for controlled direct event-time contrasts under a rank-\(r\) baseline: complete mixing preserves only early zero-sum contrasts, whereas the adoption-aligned directed cycle also preserves impact. It also establishes the exact universal permutation boundary, an explicit pair of same-cycle-type networks with different frontiers, and a sufficient relative-cycle guarantee. The displayed ambiguity directions in the exact boundary and order-counterexample results have rank-split observational-equivalence witnesses; the relative-cycle result is sufficient only. Thus the general fixed-point-free permutation iff frontier remains an explicitly order-sensitive open problem, while particular-matrix identification and noisy-sample estimation remain separate.
gap: Existing IFE work supplies abstract low-rank or realized factor/loading conditions, while interference DiD papers identify exposure-specific causal contrasts under parallel trends, overlap, support, or imputation structure. The audited statements do not enumerate all controlled direct event-time functionals invariant to simultaneous bounded-rank confounding and a known exposure column, or explain why complete mixing and an aligned cycle preserve different targets. The closest comparator, Banerjee--Wang Proposition 2 on pp. 10--11, globally identifies \(\theta,\gamma_1,\gamma_2\) under Assumptions 1--4 using treated-unexposed anchor support and positive exposure support in untreated-exposed and treated-exposed cells; Remark 2 gives local identification through positive definiteness of the full Jacobian Gram when anchors fail. It does not study the proposed arbitrary rank-\(r\) baseline or its uniform invariant-target frontier.
fill: Prove the complete-mixing and adoption-aligned cycle-family iff frontiers, retain the distinct no-spillover benchmark, and give constructive rank-split observational equivalences. Then determine whether cycle-order invariants yield an equally sharp theorem for a genuinely broader fixed-point-free permutation family.
